description: The bar chart illustrates the performance gain of three models, GPT-4o, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, and Qwen2-72B-VL, under two supervision conditions, strong and weak. The horizontal axis lists the model names in the order of GPT-4o, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, and Qwen2-72B-VL, while the vertical axis represents the performance gain in percentage, ranging from 0 to 30 with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 5. For each model, two bars are presented side by side, with the striped blue bar representing strong supervision and the solid blue bar representing weak supervision. The performance gain under strong supervision is approximately 24.5% for GPT-4o, 8% for Claude-3.5-Sonnet, and 14.5% for Qwen2-72B-VL, whereas under weak supervision, it is around 5% for GPT-4o, 3% for Claude-3.5-Sonnet, and 5% for Qwen2-72B-VL. The bars are grouped by model, with the strong supervision bar always positioned to the left of the weak supervision bar. The chart does not display any specific sorting order among the models, and no bars are visually emphasized.
